units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:56">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56</cite> <he>נְסִיאַת</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <cite ref="N01308"><he>נַסִּי׳</he></cite>, Pa.); Y. <he>נַסְיַית</he> (h. text <he>נִסְּתָה</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 4:7">Targ. Ps. IV, 7</cite> <cite ref="N01285"><he>נְשָׂא</he></cite> (h. text <cite ref="N00926"><he>נְסָה</he></cite>).—[Pesik. B’shall., p. 91ᵃ, v. <cite ref="N00924"><he>נְסַח</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>לא נַסְיָין להון</he> they (the areas described) could not receive (would have no room for) them; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:20">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לא נַסְיָיהּ</he>. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ <he>נַסְתּוֹן בר קפר</he> Bar Ḳ. took them.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:3">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>נַסְתֵּיה לקניא וכ׳</he> he took the cane and knocked it down.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, end <he>נסאתיה וחמאי ליה וכ׳</he>, read: <he>נסא יתיה ואחמי וכ׳</he> he took him along and showed to him &c.; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 355">Yalk. Is. 355</cite> <he>נסביה ואחמתיה וכ׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite> <he>נשא ואפקדיה וכ׳</he> he took (his money) and put it in trust with him.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נַסְתָּהּ ויהבה ליה</he> she took it (the deposited money) and gave it to him; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to find out by sign, to divine.

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:56">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56</cite>, v. supra.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite> <he>למְנֵסְיָא צליבא</he> to test the (strength of) the gallows.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 16:4">Targ. Ex. XVI, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:3">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַסִּינָא לך</he> I will try thee.

senses.gloss: to be tried. Targ. II Esth. V, 14.—Snh. l. c. אינהו מִינַּסּוּ לי … מִינַּסְּיַת לי they have been tried (proved true) to me, thou hast not.
